preprocessing.mirror_semantics: Synthetic image reflection, not a physically moved right-side camera: LCD digits and dial printing are reflected. Parent generating roll is retained; perspective augmentation and reflection are distinct. No speed/RPM target is changed or created.

limitations: Train/val use separated temporal blocks within three recordings, so not independent unseen-camera accuracy. Test is one heldout close-up recording with only12 real frames. Augmented samples do not add independent real recordings.
